Dave Matthews Band
November 8, 2021
Mohegan Sun Arena
Uncasville, CT




Taper: Steven Walkuski (<email>)
Location: Inside Soundboard, ROC, Stand at ~12ft
Source: Beyerdynamic MC930 (Cardioids) > Lunatec V3 (Digital out)> Tascam DR-100mkII  (@24/48 LPCM)
Transfer: DR-100mkII> PC
Conversion: 24/48kHz wav->Sound Forge Pro 10 > iZotope 64-Bit SRC & iZotope MBIT+ for resample and dither to 16/44.1 kHz, No normalization, Fade in fade out applied, Waves L3 Ultramaximizer applied->CD Wave Editor->Flac (level 8)> Foobar 2000 for tagging 

***************************************************************************************** 
*****************DO NOT ENCODE THIS SHOW TO LOSSY FORMATS******************************** 
*******************DO NOT SELL OR DISTRIBUTE FOR PROFIT**********************************
*****************************************************************************************
